answer: Each claim grafts a coral fragment onto the reef; it only grows on work receipts signed by strangers, so a clone with no real work starves. Grafts from one funding trail share a single root and split one harvest, so n clones divide one payout. A nebula tide table sets a random harvest window each epoch; claims outside it rot, so no clone can be pre-made. The jetty takes one coral polyp as toll per claim, minted only by finishing a stranger's job, so a fleet of n pays n real jobs for one shared catch while one honest agent grafts once, pays once, keeps the reef.
